cmd:
git checkout -- django/db/migrations/operations/fields.py && awk '
/^class AlterField/ { in_alter_field = 1 }
/^class RenameField/ { in_alter_field = 0 }
in_alter_field && /^    def reduce\(self, operation, app_label\):/ {
    print "    def reduce(self, operation, app_label):"
    print "        if isinstance(operation, RemoveField) and self.is_same_field_operation("
    print "            operation"
    print "        ):"
    print "            return [operation]"
    print "        elif ("
    print "            isinstance(operation, RenameField)"
    print "            and self.is_same_field_operation(operation)"
    print "            and self.field.db_column is None"
    print "        ):"
    print "            return ["
    print "                operation,"
    print "                AlterField("
    print "                    model_name=self.model_name,"
    print "                    name=operation.new_name,"
    print "                    field=self.field,"
    print "                ),"
    print "            ]"
    print "        elif isinstance(operation, AlterField) and self.is_same_field_operation("
    print "            operation"
    print "        ):"
    print "            return [operation]"
    print "        return super().reduce(operation, app_label)"
    # Skip the original method lines
    while (getline > 0 && !/^        return super\(\)\.reduce\(operation, app_label\)/) {
        # Skip lines until we reach the return statement
    }
    next
}
{ print }
' django/db/migrations/operations/fields.py > temp_fields.py && mv temp_fields.py django/db/migrations/operations/fields.py
